correctness.rationale: For Fourier shell k, the two-site evaluation is invertible except at k=j m/g, one invisible dimension per such interior shell. All spatially visible data are recovered by m+1 samples because the distinct eigenvalue Vandermonde is invertible. The m-sample Vandermonde null vector has no zero coordinate; constrained shell ratios force its two coefficients to agree, with an extra free scalar precisely when h/g is even. This rigorously proves both rank formulas and the sharp horizon counts. Exact-rational matrix ranks were independently calculated for all 120 (m,h) cases with 2<=m<=11; finite checks are not used as the proof.
